items.title: Dick Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 1, 2006
items.q: And he used to come and play tenor with us now and then, the Catatonic Five.

ctx.x: Well wait a minute. Frank Piano was a Spanish assistant professor here. And he used to come and play tenor with us now and then, the Catatonic Five. But that was the only connection we had with the faculty and the music department. He actually wasn’t in the music department, he was in the Romance Language department.
And what’s this business about — was it the president of the college at that time didn’t want no jazz on Sundays?
